description: This file contains utility functions for mapping architecture identifiers and configuration strings specific to the Xvisor virtualization project. It defines functions to determine the appropriate defconfig based on architecture identifiers and to map architecture strings to Xvisor-specific architecture names.

methods.name: get_oemake_config
methods.description: Determines the defconfig name based on architecture identifier using regular expressions.

methods.name: map_xvisor_arch
methods.description: Maps architecture identifier strings to Xvisor architecture categories using regex matching.
